dedupe_keys.name: cloud data centre workload energy and temperature logs ucc 2023 characterisation dataset

description: This dataset, published on Zenodo by Shashikant Ilager of TU Wien, holds logs of a production cloud data centre that combine the workload of its hosts with their energy use and temperatures, as analysed in 'A Data-driven Analysis of a Cloud Data Center: Statistical Characterization of Workload, Energy and Temperature' by Ilager, Toosi, Jha, Brandic and Buyya at the IEEE/ACM Utility and Cloud Computing conference (UCC 2023). The two combined CSV files let users relate CPU and memory load of hosts to their power draw and inlet or processor temperatures over time. Coverage: one cloud data centre; the operator and exact period are given in the paper, not in the record. Format and access: two CSV files of about 0.8 GB in total, free of charge under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: one facility; field definitions must be read from the paper; no facility-level cooling or grid data. Simulation uses: relations between workload, power and heat for data centre energy, thermal and failure models and digital twins, including behaviour under heat waves. Related records: the SURF Lisa and CINECA Marconi traces give HPC counterparts; the Google, Alibaba and Azure traces give workload only.
